initrd.extraUtilsCommands:
copy_bin_and_libs /nix/store/HASH-unlock/bin/unlock

# Add RAID mdadm tool.
copy_bin_and_libs /nix/store/HASH-mdadm-4.4/sbin/mdadm
copy_bin_and_libs /nix/store/HASH-mdadm-4.4/sbin/mdmon

for BIN in /nix/store/HASH-thin-provisioning-tools-1.3.0/bin/*; do
  copy_bin_and_libs $BIN
done

# Copy e2fsck and friends.
copy_bin_and_libs /nix/store/HASH-e2fsprogs-1.47.3-bin/sbin/e2fsck
copy_bin_and_libs /nix/store/HASH-e2fsprogs-1.47.3-bin/sbin/tune2fs
ln -sv e2fsck $out/bin/fsck.ext2
ln -sv e2fsck $out/bin/fsck.ext3
ln -sv e2fsck $out/bin/fsck.ext4

copy_bin_and_libs /nix/store/HASH-btrfs-progs-6.17.1/bin/btrfs
ln -sv btrfs $out/bin/btrfsck
ln -sv btrfsck $out/bin/fsck.btrfs

copy_bin_and_libs /nix/store/HASH-cryptsetup-2.8.1-bin/bin/cryptsetup
copy_bin_and_libs /nix/store/HASH-cryptsetup-askpass/bin/cryptsetup-askpass
sed -i s,/bin/sh,$out/bin/sh, $out/bin/cryptsetup-askpass








copy_bin_and_libs /nix/store/HASH-openssh-10.2p1/bin/sshd
copy_bin_and_libs /nix/store/HASH-openssh-10.2p1/libexec/sshd-auth
copy_bin_and_libs /nix/store/HASH-openssh-10.2p1/libexec/sshd-session
cp -pv /nix/store/HASH-glibc-2.40-66/lib/libnss_files.so.* $out/lib

copy_bin_and_libs /nix/store/HASH-klibc-2.0.14/lib/klibc/bin.static/ipconfig

kernel.extraModprobeConfig:
options vfio-pci ids=10de:2487,10de:228b
options kvm ignore_msrs=1 report_ignored_msrs=0

# Force GPU modules to load after VFIO (?)
softdep amdgpu pre: vfio_pci
softdep i915 pre: vfio_pci
softdep nvidia pre: vfio_pci
